source_duration.Qualification: Declared-policy phase only, with month-resolution endpoint. Exact reopening instruction, passenger subcategories and port operations are unrecovered; no claim of zero crossings or uniformly restored service. IOM July evidence is indexed; the August 7 briefing is retrospective and supplies no additional exact day. No July 17 airport date is substituted for land reopening. Contemporary IOM reporting as of July31 states Ethiopian borders remained closed, conflicting with the retrospective July resumption. The retained July bounds are disputed reported evidence, not an established legal or operational endpoint.
